name: ValenJEG
description: Unofficial Fabric port of MigaMi's Just Enough Guns. Firearms, faction raids, vehicles, special equipment, and a four-chapter survival combat career. JEG code is GPL-3.0; original JEG assets are ARR and used with author authorization. SBW/SW-derived vehicles and special-equipment assets (Javelin, Igla, drone, C4, Claymore, smoke/lock UI, etc.) require attribution to the SBW development team under CC BY-NC-SA 3.0. Private Valen fork restoring original workstations and source-backed structure integrations.
